lines.en: I swim along the flank of a big fish.
One flick of my tail and I keep up.
There is a shadow ahead; I move toward it.
The silver school turns a corner.

lines.zh: 水流被大个子分开，我借力。
lines.en: The big one splits the current; I ride it.
My stripes hide me best in dim water.
I do not lead; I only follow.
Around the coral, do not fall behind.
A meter above the sand is safe ground.
Too many companions; I squeeze into the middle.
That shark in the distance—I know it.
I swim fast but never sprint.
The water clouds; I press closer.
Following all the way from shallows to deep.
I hug the reef's lee to dodge the swell.

lines.zh: 我追着同伴的影子往前。
lines.en: I chase my neighbor's shadow onward.

lines.zh: 停在大鱼旁边，等它进食。
lines.en: I hover by the big one, waiting for it to feed.
My scales catch the light, bright as tin.

lines.zh: 这一带没有大家伙，冷清。
lines.en: No big creatures here; it feels empty.

lines.zh: 我侧着身子，让水流过鳃。
lines.en: I turn sideways to let water cross my gills.

lines.zh: 阴影里最舒服，别处太亮。
lines.en: The shade is best; elsewhere is too bright.

lines.zh: 有条小鱼在啃我的尾巴。
lines.en: A little fish is nibbling my tail.

lines.zh: 我数了数同伴，少了三条。
lines.en: I count my school; three are missing.
There are parasites on the big one's hide.
I hang in the middle, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 海草在下面摇，我不下去。
lines.en: The seagrass sways below; I stay up here.
A dull sound rolls in from the deep.

lines.zh: 沙上的影子只有巴掌大。
lines.en: My shadow on the sand is a hand's width.

lines.zh: 潮水换了方向，我也转了。
lines.en: The tide turns; I turn with it.

lines.zh: 等一个能带我走的影子。
lines.en: Waiting for a shadow worth following.
You swim slowly; I followed for a while.
Your legs are not fins; how strange.
I circle near your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你身上的气泡，一串一串。
lines.en: Bubbles trail from you in strings.

lines.zh: 你比鲨鱼小，也没那么凶。
lines.en: You are smaller than a shark, and tamer.
I tilt to look at you, stripes upward.
No food in your hands; a pity.
Where are you going? I will tag along.

lines.zh: 你的影子够大，我很满意。
lines.en: Your shadow is big enough; I am pleased.
Do not wave; it stirs up the water.
A scale came off; it stings.
Bitten—I dive into the school.
Who struck me from behind?
I swim crooked, gills burning.
A corner of my tail fin is gone.
The blow knocked me out of formation.
I am bleeding; I need cover.
Do not bite twice; I cannot take it.
The blow deadened my lateral line.
The water tastes of iron.

lines.zh: 你指缝里的碎肉，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the meat scraps between your fingers.
Bread crumbs will do; I am not fussy.

lines.zh: 桶里有水，我可以先进去。
lines.en: The bucket has water; I could go in first.
You shook the line and the bait fell off.

lines.zh: 那条受伤的鱼，味道很浓。
lines.en: That wounded fish smells strongly.

lines.zh: 我绕一圈，再决定吃不吃。
lines.en: I circle once before deciding to eat.
I eat only after the big one finishes.

lines.zh: 你把食撒开，我抢不过同伴。
lines.en: You scatter food; my school outcompetes me.
I am coming closer; do not grab suddenly.

lines.zh: 一点点就够，我胃口不大。
lines.en: A little is enough; my appetite is small.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞散了我的队。
lines.en: Your knee broke up my little school.
I bumped into your diving goggles.
Do not reach out; the school scatters.
I slipped past you; it was crowded.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩到我的同伴。
lines.en: Your boot came down near my companion.
The water lurched; I hit the bucket wall.

lines.zh: 让开一点，我要跟上队伍。
lines.en: A little space—I need to rejoin the school.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，鳞片没掉。
lines.en: We bumped; no scales lost.

lines.zh: 你挡住整条路，我绕过去。
lines.en: You block the whole path; I go around.
Do not splash; it makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 她游在我外侧，条纹对齐。
lines.en: She swims outside me, stripes aligned.
We circle on the shaded side of the reef.
My colors have deepened a shade.
The water warms; the time is right.
Her tail fin brushes against mine.
The eggs will drift away; no one can hold them.
I follow her for three full circles.
The school has made room for us.
Do not stare; we are being quiet.

lines.zh: 这是海里最普通的仪式。
lines.en: The most ordinary ceremony in the sea.
A fallen scale; I catch it in my mouth.
These crumbs barely fill the gap.
I picked it up and spat it out.
The bait on the bottom is mine.
I carry it in my mouth as I swim.
A small pebble, remarkably bright.
A bit of your line; I take it.
This is not edible; I let it go.
My schoolmate wanted it too; I got there first.
I carry it over to the big one.
A fish is bleeding; I follow it.

lines.zh: 那群小鱼散了，我挑一只。
lines.en: The school scattered; I pick one.
There are bugs on the big one's flank.

lines.zh: 那块漂浮的东西，像食物。
lines.en: That floating thing looks like food.
I have fixed on the slowest one.
Something is struggling at the surface.
It is hurt, swimming at an angle.
I must be quick before it is taken.
I circle it, looking for an angle.
Very close now; I ease off my tail.

lines.zh: 我贴着它的尾巴，等它慢。
lines.en: I stay on its tail until it slows.
It dives into the sand; I block above.

lines.zh: 我咬一口就跑，从不纠缠。
lines.en: I bite once and flee; never linger.
It turns left; I adjust with it.
My school crowds in; no room left.
I wait for its gill cover to slow.

lines.zh: 别追太远，脱离队伍危险。
lines.en: Not too far; leaving the school is dangerous.
It hit the coral and paused.
I drop my approach very low.
I have judged this step precisely.
I nip its tail base once and release.
My teeth are small but sharp enough.
I ram its gills and make it panic.
A mouthful of scales, all brine.
It slaps its tail; I dodge.
I do not linger; bite and go.
My school joins in; it cannot last.

lines.zh: 这一下是替大鱼清虫子。
lines.en: That nip cleans the big one's parasites.

lines.zh: 我的牙朝里弯，咬住不掉。
lines.en: My teeth curve inward and hold.
It turns belly-up; I back away.

lines.zh: 我跟着一条鲨鱼进来的。
lines.en: I came in behind a shark.
New water, and new shadows.

lines.zh: 我从深处游上来，鳞发亮。
lines.en: I rise from the deep, scales gleaming.
The rest of the school is still behind.
First find a big one and claim a spot.
The water is a different temperature here.
I made two circles before settling.
Plenty of fish around this coral.
I hug the rock wall and move on.
Where there is a shadow, there am I.

lines.zh: 水面像烧开，我拼命往下。
lines.en: The surface boils; I dive hard.
Dropped on hard ground, fins bent.

lines.zh: 我在水里长大，也会喘不上。
lines.en: Raised in water, yet I cannot breathe.
A muffled blast scatters my school.

lines.zh: 箭从鳃边过去，我甩了甩尾。
lines.en: An arrow passes my gills; I flick my tail.
A flash of light—my stripes blur.

lines.zh: 两天没吃东西，肚子贴背。
lines.en: Two days without food; my belly is flat.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我浑身一僵。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water; I go rigid.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我停住。
lines.en: Nothing below; I stop short.
